items.name: VBench
items.description: Evaluates video generation models across 16 disentangled dimensions of video quality and prompt-video consistency.
items.publisher: Nanyang Technological University (S-Lab) / Shanghai AI Lab

items.name: T2I-CompBench
items.description: Evaluates compositional text-to-image generation, covering attribute binding, object relationships and complex compositions.
items.publisher: University of Hong Kong / Huawei Noah's Ark Lab

items.name: GEdit-Bench
items.description: Evaluates instruction-based general image editing using real-world user editing instructions, scored by VLM judges.

items.name: AgentDojo
items.description: Evaluates LLM agents' utility and robustness to prompt injection attacks across tool-use tasks in a dynamic environment.

items.name: ChemBench
items.description: Evaluates chemical knowledge and reasoning of LLMs with curated questions compared against human chemistry experts.
items.publisher: Friedrich Schiller University Jena / Helmholtz Institute for Polymers in Energy Applications

items.name: RoboCasa
items.description: Simulation framework and benchmark of everyday household manipulation tasks in diverse kitchen scenes for training and evaluating generalist robots.

items.name: EmbodiedBench
items.description: Evaluates multimodal LLM agents on vision-driven embodied tasks across high-level planning and low-level manipulation environments.
items.publisher: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / Northwestern University

items.name: BALROG
items.description: Evaluates agentic reasoning of LLMs and VLMs on long-horizon interactive games such as NetHack, BabyAI and Crafter.
items.publisher: UCL / University of Oxford / NYU / IDSIA and collaborators

items.name: VideoGameBench
items.description: Evaluates whether vision-language models can complete popular real-time video games from raw visual input.

items.name: ForecastBench
items.description: Dynamic benchmark of questions about future events used to compare LLM forecasting accuracy against human forecasters.

items.name: Prophet Arena
items.description: Live benchmark evaluating LLMs' ability to predict real-world event outcomes from prediction-market-style questions.

items.name: FutureX
items.description: Live benchmark evaluating LLM agents on predicting future events using search and reasoning, with questions updated continuously.

items.name: BBQ
items.description: Evaluates social bias in question answering with hand-built questions on attested biases across nine social dimensions.

items.name: RAID
items.description: Evaluates robustness of machine-generated text detectors across many generators, domains, decoding strategies and adversarial attacks.

items.name: M4
items.description: Evaluates black-box detection of machine-generated text across multiple generators, domains and languages.

items.name: VerilogEval
items.description: Evaluates LLM generation of Verilog hardware description code from natural-language specifications, checked by simulation.

items.name: MemoryAgentBench
items.description: Evaluates LLM agents' memory through incremental multi-turn interactions, covering retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding and conflict resolution.

items.name: Online-Mind2Web
items.description: Evaluates web agents on live websites with tasks that need real browsing, scored by an LLM-as-judge.
items.reason: introduced in 'An Illusion of Progress?' paper

items.name: WorldScore
items.description: Unified benchmark evaluating 3D, 4D and video world generation models on camera control, object control and visual quality over scene sequences.

items.name: 3DSRBench
items.description: Evaluates 3D spatial reasoning of multimodal models on height, location, orientation and multi-object questions from natural images.

items.name: CAD-Recode
items.description: Evaluates reconstruction of CAD models as executable Python code from point clouds, with an accompanying large training dataset.

items.name: Agent Red Teaming (ART)
items.description: Benchmark of successful agent red-teaming attacks from a large public competition, measuring policy-violation robustness of AI agents.
items.publisher: Gray Swan AI / UK AI Security Institute
